scope: Frozen synthetic W1-W4 water/lake controls and bounded geometry-reuse timing. No sediment, coupled terrain, empirical geology or whole-world acceptance.

single_complete_request.scope: Fresh initial state, changed forcing values/source IDs and full 60 s evolution per request. Cold reconstructs geometry for each request; prepared constructs it once. Both include fixture creation, source checks, initialisation, output materialisation, statistics and close. Imports/interpreter and outer source audit are excluded. The same ordered request sequence is used on both routes; no complete-output hits.
single_complete_request.interpretation: No speed saving measured: prepared reuse was slower or equal.
